headline: Accepted new voter registrations and voters pending removal, and certified nomination papers for three candidates.
summary: Voter registrations and voters pending removal were each accepted by a 3-0 vote. Nomination papers were certified for three candidates: Stephen Villee for Governor, and Edmond Laplante and Aaron Day for US Senate.
decisions: Certified nomination papers for Libertarian candidate Stephen Villee for Governor.
Certified nomination papers for Constitution party candidate Edmond Laplante for US Senate.
Certified nomination papers for Independent candidate Aaron Day for US Senate.

decision_evidence.quote: Motion to accept new voter registrations by Supervisor Messina. Seconded by Supervisor Dombroski. Motion passed 3-0. List of accepted voters attached.

Motionto accept voters pending removal dueto transfers to other towns, notification via NCOA,return of 30 dayletters, death or other reasons by Supervisor Dombroski. Seconded by Supervisor Strakalaikis. Motion passed 3-0. List of removed voters attached.
Nomination papers reviewed andcertified for Libertarian party candidate Stephen Villee for Governor.
Nomination papers reviewed andcertified for Constitution party candidate Edmond Laplante for US Senate.
Nomination papers reviewed andcertified for Independent party candidate Aaron Day for US Senate.

decision_titles: Nomination papers for Libertarian candidate Stephen Villee
